title: Ulyana and the Asset
author: Oscar Almeida
blurb: Sable Halloran, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
